system.description: An ochre jelly is an ochre-colored giant amoeba that can be harmed only by fire or cold. It can seep through small cracks, and destroy wood, leather, and cloth in 1 round, but cannot eat through metal or stone. Attacks with weapons or lightning merely make 1d4 + 1 smaller (2 Hit Dice) ochre jellies. A normal ochre jelly causes 2d6 points of damage per round to exposed flesh. Smaller ochre jellies inflict only half damage. Odic
